name: code-shell
description: Coding loop: read, edit, patch, run tests, format and analyze code.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Reproduce and fix a defect in the workspace
commands.template: Reproduce and fix the following defect in the workspace, then run the tests: {input}

commands.name: test
commands.description: Write or run the failing test first
commands.template: Write or run the failing test for: {input}. Show the failing command and output first, then the smallest fix, then the passing run.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review a change for concrete risks
commands.template: Review the change described by: {input}. Report correctness, security and regression risks with file:line evidence; no style-only findings.

changelog: 1.1.0 - DoD pass: skill pack with two examples, commands, changelog and README entry.
